scope: Bounded independent source review and synthetic execution/analysis tests of the versioned continuous64k driver. Not an execution-plan review or spending authorization.
invariants_checked: Each request reserves its entire input/output maximum atomically in the existing lifetime ledger before any POST.
Incomplete aggregate liability equals known settled costs plus full unknown reservations; rejected high-usage receipts retain the larger observed liability.
Legacy committed/protected calculations see all liabilities; provider hard caps and planning reserves remain enforced.
The ledger ownership fence prevents overlapping legacy submissions; batch_id=None prevents legacy collection.
One process flock and at most32 combined workers; shared ledger lock is absent during network calls.
Exact index-prefix and request digests prevent replay; uncertain outcomes stop admission, drain existing requests and retain reservations.
Restart cannot resubmit unknown or completed requests; previous final task membership is rejected across versioned and legacy final jobs.

Task, public prompt, source policy, independent input review, scorer adoption, spelling review and frozen code hashes are verified before execution; frozen plan/dependency hashes are checked again before each POST.
Test split and full canonical keys regenerate at registration. All final questions have the original4D shape and same model-visible prompt under both provider adapters.
Paired analysis reads no response text or scorer until both exact fixed cohorts have terminal validated usage.
Final analysis binds raw receipt bytes and paid request intents; canonical and predeclared finite-spelling rows are retained separately.
Every usable unrecognized answer remains pending source adjudication; iid and family precision are separate and benchmark_ready stays false.
operational_limits: No concrete execution plan, counting receipts, spending-pool allocation, scorer/source adoption or reserve-reallocation document was approved by this code review. Those remain separately hash-bound gates.
The new fixed-cohort final phase explicitly replaces legacy core/extension staging for its own runs; legacy16k phase records stay unchanged. It must not be registered as a development job.

Conservative reservations bound each admission, not the cost of completing all1800 questions in advance. Exhausted headroom returns an incomplete evaluation without score-based stopping or dropping questions.
Transport/unknown-usage failures intentionally need reconciliation; no automatic paid retry or unknown-reservation release is supplied.

Generic legacy dashboards do not assemble scores for this new phase; use its usage-only execution status and full-paired analysis. The existing spending fence needs explicit coordinator handling after completion.
The finite spelling policy is incomplete by design.79candidate tasks flag remaining cluster contexts; full paradigm/source certification and subsequent symmetric adjudication remain separate.
